title: Forge Workspace
description: Workspace chrome: header, undo/redo toolbar, docks, floating panels, status line. Needs StudioUIProvider, @nyc-tron controls, studio-layout.

title: Forge Document Stage
description: Workspace chrome: read-only stage of live engine state (text, cells, slides, tracks, shapes). Needs StudioUIProvider and studio-layout.

title: Quill Text Editor
description: Writing surface: draft applied as one edit, conflict on outside change. Needs StudioUIProvider and a Quill document with apply and reload.

title: Prism Editor
description: Vector canvas editor: shape tools, layers, transforms, personas. Needs ignition and editor-controls first, StudioUIProvider, @nyc-tron.

title: Prism Canvas
description: Artboard: transparency checker, selection outline, one-finger drag to move bounds. Needs StudioUIProvider and studio-gesture.

title: Studio Gesture
description: Gesture primitive: one-finger pan recognizer, PanResponder on web, Gesture Handler on native. No provider needed.

title: Persona Turret
description: Persona switcher dial with four stops. Drag or arrows preview, Enter commits. Needs StudioUIProvider, studio-theme, forge-directions.

title: Persona Composer
description: Persona form: name it, order instruments, pick capabilities, save, export, import. Needs StudioUIProvider and a PersonaStore.

title: Persona Model
description: Persona data, not UI: 4 personas, 11 capabilities, 7 surfaces, compose, import, export, per-document store. No provider needed.

title: Instrument System
description: Instrument policy, not UI: 18 blueprints, precision scrubbing math, ruler ticks, motion budgets, overlay planner. No provider needed.

title: Workspace Utilities
description: Helpers, not UI: APP_MANIFESTS (task line, glyph, category per studio), jsonProblem (JSON parse error as a sentence). Needs studio-layout.

title: Studio UI Provider
description: Provider: StudioUIProvider supplies the 27 UI slots. Every studio component throws without it. Fill the slots with nyc-tron-host.

title: NYC-Tron Host
description: Provider adapter: nycTronStudioUI() maps @nyc-tron controls onto the StudioUIProvider slots. Needs the @nyc-tron tarballs installed.

title: Studio Theme
description: Theme: dark and light tokens, densities, generated theme.css (Tailwind v4) and theme.native.css (Uniwind). build:theme regenerates both.

title: Forge Directions
description: Theme: workbench, optics and atelier palettes for Prism chrome and the persona turret, plus WCAG contrast helpers. Needs studio-theme.

title: Forge Icon
description: Icon: outline when idle, filled when selected. 47 glyphs drawn of 1,463 reserved ids; others render nothing. Needs react-native-svg.

title: Forge Icon Button
description: Icon: pressable ForgeIcon with a 44 by 44 hit target. Throws TypeError on a blank label. Needs forge-icon and react-native-svg.
